Usage

When to use. The Add menu is the entry point from the chat input’s + button for bringing content and capabilities into a conversation — adding content, uploading files, attaching cloud files, adding capabilities, and changing data sources. It is a standard Menu: reuse MenuListItem rows and Dividers rather than bespoke layout.

Do

  • Anchor it to the + button and open Above, left-aligned to the trigger.
  • Group related actions with Dividers (add/upload/attach · capabilities · data sources).
  • Give branching items (Add capabilities) a trailing chevron to signal a submenu.
  • Compose from MenuListItem + the Menu Popover surface — don’t re-style rows.

Don't

  • Overload it — keep to the core add / upload / attach / capabilities / sources set.
  • Mix secondary text or avatars into these rows; they are simple icon + label.
  • Detach the menu from the + trigger or open it far from the anchor.
  • Use a chevron on non-branching items.
